claims.text: The experiments involved translation systems trained on various basic units including character, morpheme, word, orthographic syllable, and BPE unit.
The experiments spanned 16 language pairs, 17 languages, and 10 writing systems, indicating a diverse dataset.
The chosen languages represent 4 major language families and exhibit diversity in word order and morphological complexity.
